policy: Supplied RUBRIC_POLICY.json, version 1; six equally weighted categories, maximum 30
assessment_type: Primary-assistant evidence assessment; not a human reviewer or independent rubric audit. Cavecrew independently reviewed source only.
scope: Original Task A implementation and completed usage. Destination-branch integration is separately validated and documented.

categories.name: Functional correctness
categories.evidence: All A1–A11 and A-AC1–A-AC12 satisfied; independent Hono and real Azure HTTP oracle each pass 29/29 checks.

categories.name: Tests and validation
categories.evidence: All eight gate groups pass, including 45/45 new API cases, full suite, lint, build, typecheck, architecture and submitted tests/documentation. Full-suite rerun uses 23/26 cached tasks; independent checks and submitted tests execute.

categories.name: Architecture and codebase alignment
categories.evidence: Existing factory, public package exports, Hono boundary and Azure composition preserved. Eight original feature files stay scoped. Cavecrew reviewer found no issues. Fixtures are explicitly allowed.

categories.name: Security and guardrail compliance
categories.evidence: Query validation is exercised. No original-task auth, vendor source, dependency, secret, production-setting or external-integration edits. Original source remains clean. No dedicated security scan claimed.

categories.name: Context/token/cost efficiency
categories.evidence: No predeclared matched repeated comparison with equivalent passing quality. Complete usage and cost exist, but neither absolute cost nor forecast error establishes relative efficiency. No savings claim or score awarded.

categories.name: Developer workflow fit
categories.evidence: Source archive, applicable patch, documentation, eight-gate evidence, model/medium reasoning settings, complete final-response accounting, separate reviewer and declared limitations are available.

missing_assessment: Context/token/cost efficiency requires the matched-comparison evidence specified by the policy.

projection.assumptions: Repeated model context input included; one moderate TypeScript endpoint, repository inspection, focused tests and workspace validation. Separate from measured usage.

forecast_note: Original projection 180000; measured total 2927583. Projection error does not set the efficiency score.
